content_sections.heading: South Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Quota Vacancy 2026-27
content_sections.text: South Eastern Railway has announced a total of 10 vacancies under Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026-27. The vacancy details are given below.

content_sections.heading: South Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026-27 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for South Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026-27 must fulfil the required educational qualification and Scouts & Guides eligibility conditions. Passed 12th (+2 stage) or equivalent examination with minimum 50% marks from a recognized board. 50% marks requirement is not applicable for SC, ST, ESM, PwBD candidates and candidates having higher qualifications from UGC recognized universities. OR 10th Pass from recognized board plus National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) / ITI approved by NCVT. Candidates must also possess the required Scouts/Guides qualification. 10th Pass or ITI or equivalent qualification. National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT. Required Scouts/Guides qualification. The qualification requirements for Level-1 posts are mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: South Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Qualification 2026-27
content_sections.text: Along with educational qualification, candidates must fulfil the Scouts & Guides qualification requirements for both Level-1 and Level-2 posts. President Scout/Guide/Rover/Ranger OR Himalayan Wood Badge (HWB) holder in any section. Active member of Scouts Organization for the last 5 years. Should have attended two National Level or All Indian Railways level events and two State Level events. These Scouts & Guides requirements are mandatory for both categories of posts.

content_sections.heading: South Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Quota Age Limit 2026-27
content_sections.text: The age limit will be calculated as on 01 January 2027. Age relaxation will be applicable as per government rules for eligible categories. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: South Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Quota Application Fee 2026-27
content_sections.text: Candidates paying Rs. 500 will receive a refund of Rs. 400 after appearing in the written examination. Eligible candidates from SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, PwBD, Women, Minority and EBC categories will receive a refund of Rs. 250 after appearing in the written examination.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for South Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
content_sections.text: Visit the official RRC/SER website. Click on the online application link for Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026-27. Complete new registration using personal details. Login using the registration number and password. Fill the application form carefully. Upload photograph, signature, LTI and required certificates. Pay the application fee online. Submit the application form and keep a printout for future reference. Candidates are required to apply online through the RRC/SER website only. Applications sent directly to RRC/SER will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for South Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Application
content_sections.text: Passport size photograph Signature and Left Thumb Impression (LTI) Educational qualification certificates Scouts & Guides qualification certificates Date of birth proof Caste certificate, if applicable EWS/EBC/Minority/PwBD certificates, if applicable Candidates must upload self-attested certificates related to educational qualification and Scouts & Guides achievements along with the application form.

content_sections.heading: South Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026-27 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of the following stages: Written Test Marks on Scouts & Guides Certificates Document Verification Medical Examination Eligible candidates will be called for written examination. Candidates up to five times the notified vacancies who secure minimum qualifying marks will be called for certificate verification. Final merit will be prepared based on written test marks and Scouts & Guides certificate marks. Total Marks: 60 Marks Duration: 60 Minutes Questions related to Scouts and Guides organization, activities and General Knowledge. Negative marking of one-third marks for every wrong objective answer. The written test will contain 40 objective questions (40 marks) and one essay-type question (20 marks). Certificate marks carry 40 marks based on Scouts & Guides activities such as participation in national events, state events, specialized courses and district rallies.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in South Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies are available, including 02 Level-2 (Group C) posts and 08 Level-1 posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SER Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 06 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for South Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Candidates have to submit their applications online through the official website of Railway Recruitment Cell, South Eastern Railway (RRC/SER).

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for SER Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written test, certificate marks evaluation, document verification and medical examination.

faq.question: Q5. Is Scouts & Guides qualification mandatory for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must possess the prescribed Scouts & Guides qualification to apply for these posts.

faq.question: Q6. Who can apply for South Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Candidates who fulfil the required educational qualification and possess the prescribed Scouts & Guides qualification can apply for Level-1 and Level-2 posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for South Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 30 years for Level-2 (Group C) posts and 18 to 33 years for Level-1 posts. The age will be calculated as on 01 January 2027.
